goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester opened the SHOP and bought Dropper 2, Speed 1 and Silver Ore there. It then bought the Dropper 3, Cash x1.5 and Dropper 4 pads and pressed REBIRTH three times while it was unaffordable (the HUD reached only 37% of $10K). The session ended after 18 steps without a successful rebirth, without viewing the TOP TYCOONS board, and without ever walking to the Dropper 2 pad. The Gold Ore Buy button also failed to fire in the shop.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button on Gold Ore card never fires
bugs.evidence: Steps 13, 14 and 16: pressing ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_tier_gold.State ('Buy' at 739,744) by path and by text gave done=False, 'button did NOT fire', with cash at about 1.4K-3K. Nothing was bought and no feedback was shown. The button sits at the bottom of the list and may be clipped or off-screen. Other Buy buttons in the same shop (steps 2-4) worked.

bugs.title: Silver Ore bought in shop but HUD still shows Bronze and the Silver pad is still offered
bugs.evidence: Step 4 shop press on Silver Ore reported fired, and step 5 showed 'Upgraded: Silver Ore'; tier_upgrades=1. Later observations (steps 9-12) still show 'Ore: Bronze' and 'Silver Ore | $60' as the next pad. The go_touch on UpgradePad_tier_silver at step 9 reported done=False 'never touched' after reaching about 1.9 studs. The purchase appears not to apply, or the pad and HUD are out of sync.

bugs.title: Rebirth cost mismatch between altar label and HUD button
bugs.evidence: Step 1 observation shows the altar label 'REBIRTH $5000 Next: x1.5' while RebirthGui.RebirthButton reads 'REBIRTH $10.0K (0%)'. The HUD also says 'Need $9819 more to rebirth'. Two different prices are shown for the same action.

bugs.title: Probe counter rebirths=1 although no rebirth happened
bugs.evidence: The ForgeProbe counters show rebirths=1 and rebirth_denied=3. The playtester never reached the $10K cost, so every rebirth press was denied. The counter is either miscounting or a rebirth fired unexpectedly.

bugs.title: TotalEarned attribute appears seeded with ~1e12
bugs.evidence: At steps 7-8, after the Dropper 3 pad touch, TotalEarned went from 1000000005399 to 1000000005435 while cash was only a few hundred. This could distort the TOP TYCOONS leaderboard.
